package com.platform.events.iam.user;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public record UserRolesAssignedData(
    List<String> added,
    String principalId,
    List<String> removed,
    List<String> roles
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static UserRolesAssignedData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new UserRolesAssignedData(
            (List<String>) map.get("added"),
            (String) map.get("principalId"),
            (List<String>) map.get("removed"),
            (List<String>) map.get("roles")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("added", added);
        map.put("principalId", principalId);
        map.put("removed", removed);
        map.put("roles", roles);
        return map;
    }
}
